## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:463` — own ids: `grep -oE '\bFR-[0-9]+\b' "$spec"`; unchanged (a spec declares bare ids).
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:467–474` — the scanned set: code extensions under `tests/`/`test/`/`spec/` OR any file whose NAME contains `test`/`spec`. This includes `hooks/speckit-helper.sh`, `hooks/spec-cite-probe.sh`, `hooks/spec-root-lib.sh`, `hooks/implement-phase-test-guard.sh` themselves — so any literal qualified example token in those files becomes a citation.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:482` — `grep -nHwF -- "$id"`: `-w` treats `/` as a non-word char, so `FR-001` matches inside `alpha/FR-001`. This is the FR-002 trap.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:496` — `others` = every id declared by any spec in the root; ELSEWHERE vs UNKNOWN for bare ids.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:513` — verdict: `uncovered == 0 && unknown == 0`; ELSEWHERE never fails.
- `hooks/spec-cite-probe.sh:40` — `grep -ohwE 'FR-[0-9]+'` — same `/` trap; `:54` attributes a hit to every spec whose spec.md contains the id.
- `tests/smoke.sh:1075–1092` — dogfood: on a branch with a spec, `FR-NNN UNCOVERED` rows for done-task FRs fail, and ANY `FR-NNN UNKNOWN` row fails. Rows are matched as `^FR-[0-9]+ +STATUS` — the row shape is a contract (spec D4).

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Helper predicates: matrix on stdout, verdict in exit code; `die` on missing preconditions (constitution 5; `speckit-helper.sh:459,464`).
- Smoke fixtures are throwaway `mktemp -d` repos with `printf`-written specs/tests, each assertion mutation-checked and the mutation recorded in a comment (`tests/smoke.sh:1015–1019,1056–1057,1439–1440`; constitution 3).
- Code runs on stock macOS bash 3.2 + BSD grep (memory: macOS portability; `smoke-macos` CI) — no associative arrays, no `grep -P`.

## Measured facts (this repository, 2026-11-06)
- `req-coverage --all`: 15 shipped specs checked, 0 failing, 8 in progress; each shipped run lists 10–33 ids "declared by other specs".
- ~1000 bare `FR-NNN` tokens in scanned files (434 in `tests/smoke.sh`, 222 in `tests/smoke-spec-roots.sh`, 140 in `tests/smoke-github-board.sh`, …). No spec-qualified token exists yet.
- Existing `X/FR-NNN` shapes are id LISTS, not qualifiers: `tests/smoke.sh:1503` (`FR-001/FR-002`), `:1504`, `:5311`; `hooks/ledger-lanes.sh:45`, `hooks/session-start-context.sh:43`. A naive `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/FR-[0-9]+` parse reads `FR-001` as a spec name → UNKNOWN → the repo goes red.
